title: RUNTIME_ASSET_LOSS: distributed ADD INDEX loses an internal Pebble engine SST

payload.validation_scope: Live distributed ADD INDEX on testbed 8220955 with current dirty Linux/amd64 failpoint build plus same-operation asset-type control.
payload.user_symptom: The ALTER client receives ERROR 2013 and the TiDB process executing the DDL subtask exits; a survivor may later finish the job.
payload.quality_gate: Known-root rediscovery asset for upstream #65958; final table consistency is green, but serving-front loss and delayed failover are independently user-visible.

provenance.source: current TiDB source, testbed 8220955, and asset-type differential

name: DDL local engine runtime and DXF failover

state_model: DXF persists task/subtask state and assigns a local executor
read-index builds raw ingest SSTs and an internal Pebble local engine DB
SetTSBeforeImportEngine precedes import and is a natural pause
a missing raw input SST is retryable, while an internal DB SST referenced by the open Pebble version reaches MustExist
source_anchors: Pebble ingest.go:387-394 raw input FS.Open returns error
observed_gap: internal local engine DB loss exits the serving TiDB process
DXF failover later reassigns the task and completes the DDL
raw input loss is a green retry/rebuild control

provenance.source: current source plus live red/green asset-type matrix

name: Temporary DDL engine corruption must not terminate the serving TiDB front

payload.p_check: After SetTSBeforeImportEngine, the DDL task has durable DXF state and an open local Pebble engine DB with internal SST files.
payload.q_claim: If that temporary local engine asset disappears, the next import step should return a recoverable subtask error or a clean terminal DDL failure without killing the serving TiDB process.
payload.fault: Delete the internal <engine_uuid> directory containing 000004.sst immediately before import; compare with deleting only the raw <engine_uuid>.sst input file.

boundary.before: SetTSBeforeImportEngine has completed and import has not started
boundary.after: Pebble import returns or fatally logs the missing internal table file, then DXF chooses retry/failover

consumers: ALTER TABLE ... ADD INDEX through distributed ingest

provenance.source: job 5151 red plus job 5148 green control

name: Delete internal Pebble local engine DB directory

payload.injection_type: external testbed file deletion during a test-only pause

trigger_condition.phase: after SetTSBeforeImportEngine and before import start
trigger_condition.required_evidence: engineUUID is logged, internal <engine_uuid>/000004.sst exists, and front is alive

payload.observer_action: Record client error, /proc and status-port liveness, task exec_id migration, final DDL state, and table/index/admin-check oracles

required_observations: actual TiDB process disappearance from /proc or status port
same task/subtask exec_id moves to survivor
table scan, forced index scan, default scan, and ADMIN CHECK TABLE agree
payload.red_interpretation: Availability RED if the serving front exits and failover is delayed, even if final table state is correct.
payload.green_interpretation: Asset-type control is GREEN when missing raw input is converted into bounded retry/rebuild without process death and final oracles agree.
anti_oracles: single SQL client error without process proof

provenance.source: job 5151 red and job 5148 green control

name: ADD INDEX local engine DB loss with DXF failover

payload.setup: testbed 8220955, three temporary TiDB fronts, tidb_max_dist_task_nodes=1, 10000-row non-partitioned table
sequence: delete internal Pebble engine DB directory
observe DXF move task 630002 to executor 4001
run final rowset and ADMIN CHECK oracles
payload.expected_control: Delete only raw input SST at pauseBeforeLocalDBIngest; task retries and rebuilds without process death.

rationale: the target is the runtime asset boundary identified from the proof obligation
the oracle separates process availability from final DDL correctness
the fault targets the exact internal DB asset consumed by the import path

environment.runner: three temporary Linux/amd64 TiDB fronts in fp-tidb

evidence.oracle: internal engine DB loss must not kill serving front
evidence.red_observation: client ERROR 2013; 4000 process absent from /proc; Pebble orig err/list err; task 630002 moved to exec_id 4001; job 5151 later synced

lessons.root_cause: internal Pebble DB asset loss reaches a fatal logger boundary instead of a recoverable DDL subtask boundary
lessons.severity_note: availability RED with delayed self-heal; keep separate from wrong-result and permanent-hang claims
lessons.method_note: process liveness and exec_id migration are mandatory observers

environment.runner: same three temporary Linux/amd64 TiDB fronts

evidence.oracle: raw input loss should retry/rebuild without process death
evidence.green_observation: raw <engine_uuid>.sst input deleted; subtask saw context canceled, was retried from an empty folder, job 5148 became synced and table/index counts were both 10000

lessons.method_note: Adjacent asset type control prevents overbroad attribution to local file loss.

match.fix_locus: protect active local-engine job directories from tmp_ddl cleanup

asset_value: process liveness and DXF failover oracle
